name: Swiparr
description: Swiparr is a fun way to discover and decide what to watch next from your Jellyfin media library. Think "Tinder for Movies" – swipe through your library, match with friends in a session, and find something everyone wants to watch.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Path to the application data folder

variables.name: Jellyfin - URL
variables.description: Internal URL to your Jellyfin server.

variables.name: Jellyfin - Public URL
variables.description: (Optional) Public URL to your Jellyfin server. Defaults to the internal URL if not set.

variables.name: Jellyfin - Use Watchlist
variables.description: Set to true to use Watchlist instead of Favorites

variables.name: Use Secure Cookies
variables.description: Set to true if accessing Swiparr over HTTPS

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: (Optional) A Jellyfin username that will always have admin privileges.

variables.name: Auth Secret
variables.description: Random string (min 32 chars). Generated automatically if not set.

variables.name: Internal Database Path
variables.description: Internal path to database. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Port
variables.description: Internal port Swiparr listens on. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Host
variables.description: Internal host Swiparr binds to. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: X-Frame Options
variables.description: X-Frame-Options header. Set to DISABLED to remove.
